close_reason: Re-baseline (PKIX-lwr9.6, 2026-05-11) eliminated this entire bucket. Zero of the 22 'no path to a trusted anchor' cases this bead was framed around are present in the post-.6 StricterThanWild residuals. The failures were the harness bypassing pkix-path-builder entirely; PKIX-yn3e (AKI-based candidate selection, shipped 2026-05-08) already provides the cross-signed candidate selection this bead would have added. Closing as phantom problem per the empirical re-baseline.
description:
## Why

The largest single bucket in the bettertls::pathbuilding failures: ~22 cases where pkix-path emits 'no path to a trusted anchor' because pkix-path-builder selects the first candidate intermediate by issuer-DN match, fails verification against the leaf, and gives up. RFC 4158 §3.2 specifies trying multiple candidates when one fails.

## What

In pkix-path-builder, when multiple bundle certs match a given subject-DN as candidate issuers (e.g., a self-signed root and a cross-signed intermediate of the same logical CA both share the DN), the builder must try each one and accept the first that yields a valid chain via signature verification, not pick the first by some arbitrary order.

Implementation sketch:

- Bundle search: when looking for the issuer of cert C, collect ALL candidate certs whose Subject matches C.Issuer (after RFC 4518 string prep), not just the first.
- For each candidate, attempt signature verification of C against the candidate's SPKI. If it verifies, the candidate is the issuer for this hop. If none verifies, the chain has no issuer for C and path building dead-ends.
- AKI/SKI hint: when the AuthorityKeyIdentifier on C is present, prefer the candidate whose SubjectKeyIdentifier matches. RFC 4158 §3.2 says AKI/SKI should narrow the search but not be the sole criterion (some chains lack AKI/SKI; matching SubjectDN is the fallback).

## Acceptance

- [ ] Cross-signed candidate selection lands in pkix-path-builder (NOT in pkix-path, which stays positional per AGENTS.md).
- [ ] The ~22 'no path to a trusted anchor' bettertls cases flip to Pass.
- [ ] AKI/SKI hinting is used when available, with SubjectDN-only as fallback (RFC 4158 §3.2).
- [ ] No regression on PKITS baseline.
- [ ] No regression on the existing non-bettertls limbo cases.

## Depends on

PKIX-lwr9.1 (fixtures + test scaffolding).

## Filed by

PKIX-lwr9 decomposition decision 2026-05-11 (Mark).

title: pkix-path-builder: cross-signed intermediate candidate selection
